content: Teal: kanban + table job tracker (Saved/Applied/Interview/Offer/Rejected), Chrome extension one-click save from 50+ boards auto-scraping title/company/salary/skills, excitement rating, notes, reminders, contacts CRM, cover letter generator, 40+ email templates, per-application checklists. Users value most: one place for scattered saved jobs. Complaint: feature overload; AI skill suggestions often wrong.
